card.name: Scattered spots before facility or tip words
card.fires_on: No single word or setting. It fires on varied small words and symbols, such as an opening parenthesis, a digit, 'as', 'to' and 'the', mostly in a physics facility news story, and once in syringe instructions.

modes.label: Physics facility text
modes.description: Punctuation or small linking words in a news story about an X-ray laser facility or collider physics.
